# Scenario Seedance 2.5 Music Video

Public Agent Skill for turning an authorized music master of at least 30 seconds into one fully assembled and verified MP4 through Scenario MCP.

Primary instructions: `SKILL.md`
Model boundary: `references/model-contract.md`
Music analysis: `references/music-analysis-and-treatment.md`
Shot design: `references/shot-design-and-prompting.md`
Scenario operations: `references/scenario-production.md`
Assembly and QA: `references/assembly-and-qa.md`
Examples: `references/examples.md`
Evidence: `references/source-ledger.md`
Packaging: `scripts/package_skill.py`

Core rule: Seedance footage is generated with `generateAudio: false`; the immutable supplied master is muxed once as the final soundtrack. Every supplied or generated reference pack requires explicit approval, and every shot preserves planning plus paid-attempt provenance.
